entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I... I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-015. I just feel so bad about this.
Okay, thank you. I'm pulling up your account now. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. It's just... I guess I've changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy before the new year, and I honestly just don't use it. I thought I'd be more active.
I see. So it's not meeting your expectations?

It's not the band's fault, it's me. I've been a VeloFit customer for a while and I love your products, but this time I just jumped the gun. With bills stacking up this month, I was really hoping I could get the money back.
I understand completely. Let me just check the purchase date and our policy for you. Please hold for one moment.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I see here that the item was delivered 27 days ago, on December 15th. I've checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Wait, really? Oh, my gosh, that is such a huge relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you, Isaac!

You're very welcome. I'm sending the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your full refund back to the original payment method.
That's fantastic. You've really helped me out today. I appreciate it so much.
Happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
